inputs.text: A graduation ceremony should honor achievement, discipline, and the hard work of families—not become a stage for viral confrontation. If there are administrative failures, they should be addressed through proper channels and answered by the university, whose silence only deepens distrust. Calling every public disruption a “brave stand” risks teaching students that spectacle matters more than order and responsibility.
